title: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
title_zh: 用于高效图像生成的扩散动态标记合并

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出了“动态感知标记合并”（DaTMe）框架，通过结合时间信号和结构信号来决定哪些图像标记可以合并，从而提高扩散模型的生成效率。 Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出了“动态感知标记合并”（DaTMe）框架，通过结合时间信号和结构信号来决定哪些图像标记可以合并，从而提高扩散模型的生成效率。标记合并已成为一种有效的免训练加速扩散模型的策略，通过减少冗余标记计算，同时将生成质量的下降降至最低。 一个关键挑战是确定哪些标记可以被安全地合并，哪些应该被保留以用于后续计算。 现有方法通过保留与提示词对齐的前景区域来解决这个问题，从而保护语义相关的结构。 然而，这种基于文本相关性的准则忽略了提示词中未明确提及的背景物体和局部细节，导致结构连贯性下降。 在本工作中，我们提出了动态感知标记合并（DaTMe），这是一个将标记合并建立在底层扩散动态之上的免训练框架。 我们的核心洞察是，标记的重要性应当反映该标记在去噪过程中是否仍未被解析，以及它是否携带结构信息。 为此，DaTMe 基于 Tweedie 去噪估计构建了一个动态感知的重要性图。 该图将度量预测干净图像在步骤间变化的时间信号，与捕捉边界和精细细节等局部高频内容的结构信号相结合。 利用该图，DaTMe 在给定压缩比下自适应地为标记分配合并角色：重要的标记被保留为锚点，而同时在时间上已稳定且在结构上同质的标记则被选为安全的合并候选。 在 PixArt-α 和 FLUX 上的实验表明，DaTMe 在整幅图像上都能保持视觉保真度，凸显了扩散动态作为高效生成中有效的标记级合并决策的价值。 我们的代码发布于 https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe。
